name: Any Bossbar Auto Start Stop Watcher

nodes.value: Bossbar disappeared. Macro stopped and is armed for the next bossbar.

ANY BOSSBAR AUTO START / STOP

WHAT IT DOES
- Starts this selected macro automatically when a boss bar appears.
- Checks every 500 ms while the boss bar is visible.
- Stops when no matching boss bar is visible.
- Arms itself again, so the next matching boss bar can start it.

IMPORTANT SETUP
- Keep this macro slot selected.
- Leave Auto set to Off. Event: Bossbar starts it by itself.
- Use Litemacro 1.0.81 or newer.

WHAT TO EDIT
1. Wake When Bossbar Appears
   Field 1 is the boss-bar name or text. Blank means ANY boss bar.
   Field 2 is contains, exact, or regex.
2. Is Bossbar Still Visible
   Use the same Field 1 and Field 2 as the wake component.
3. Started Message
   Replace this with the actions you want to run, or connect more actions after it.
4. Check Every Half Second
   Change 500 to a different check delay in milliseconds.

MATCH EXAMPLES
- Blank + contains: any visible boss bar.
- Wither + contains: text containing Wither.
- Wither + exact: only a bar named exactly Wither.
- Wither|Dragon + regex: either Wither or Dragon.

RUNTIME DATA
- ${bossbar.text} = visible boss-bar name.
- ${bossbar.percent} = whole percentage from 0 to 100.
- ${bossbar.progress} = decimal progress from 0.0 to 1.0.

Use these values in Local Message, Chat / Command, or Discord Notification. Example: Boss ${bossbar.text} is at ${bossbar.percent}%.

Keep the true output of Is Bossbar Still Visible connected back to the Wait. Keep false connected to the stopped message and Stop Macro.
